candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from downstream latency: gateway POST /v1/orders to order times out (~2s ReadTimeout), and order's call to payment /v1/authorizations also ReadTimeouts, propagating 502 to /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment ReadTimeout but no payment-side telemetry; exact slow dependency (payment vs order internal) not fully isolated.

report.explanation: Gateway logs show repeated 502 on /v1/checkout with ~2s durations and transport errors calling order /v1/orders; traces show ReadTimeout on order and payment calls. Consistent with downstream latency propagating to checkout. Payment-side evidence missing to fully localize.
